definition: An experiment that systematically removes or modifies components of a model or system to measure each component's contribution to overall performance.
details: Ablation studies are a standard scientific practice in ML research papers, helping researchers and readers understand which architectural choices or training techniques actually matter for a reported result.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. Here is the short version: An experiment that systematically removes or modifies components of a model or system to measure each component's contribution to overall performance. The part that makes it sing: Ablation studies are a standard scientific practice in ML research papers, helping researchers and readers understand which architectural choices or training techniques actually matter for a reported result. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Ablation Study.
